title: Knowledge
intro: What the assistant is allowed to read when a caller asks a question. Everything is indexed on this machine.
shared_note: One library, shared. Each source is read only by the assistants it is assigned to.
hours_note: Not a document — the agent reads these as data. Booking never offers a slot outside them, routing switches to the out-of-hours assistant, and callers who ask get the exact answer.
closures_note: Austrian public holidays are closed automatically. A closure you add here wins over the weekly hours, and the agent says why it is closed rather than only that it is.
empty_title: The assistant has nothing to read
empty_body: It can still take messages and move appointments, but every question about your business gets “I don’t know”. Add your opening hours and price list first — that covers most of what callers ask.
source_hours_detail: Covers hours, prices per session, and what insurance reimburses.
source_site_detail: Whole website except pages behind the customer login.
source_terms_detail: The paragraph the assistant quoted to Ms Gruber this morning.
source_faq_detail: Written answers to what callers actually ask. Quoted word for word instead of paraphrased.
source_parking_detail: Courtyard entrance from Lindengasse, lift on the left.
source_oldprices_detail: Superseded by the 2026 list. Two callers were quoted the wrong price from it.
test_answer: A quote is valid for ten weeks from the day it was issued. If yours is older, we have to price the job again before we start.
test_source: From “Terms and billing rules”, page 2 · 240 ms
test_note: Asking here does not create a call and is not recorded.
gap_card: Can I pay by card on site?
gaps_note: Each of these ended with a callback promise. One written pair usually removes the whole queue.
dialog_note: Indexed on this machine and never sent anywhere else.
text_note: Saved as a Markdown file on this machine. Headings become the sections the assistant quotes from.
qa_heading: Write a question and its answer
qa_note: The wording a caller uses, and the sentence the assistant says back. Quoted word for word, not paraphrased.
qa_answer_placeholder: Yes — on Tuesdays and Thursdays. A visit lasts about 45 minutes and is charged at the hourly rate.
qa_answer_note: Said as written. Keep it to what a person would say on the phone — one or two sentences.
files_note: Scanned pages go through OCR, which is slower and less exact than a text PDF.
web_note: Links are followed on this domain only. Pages behind the customer login are never read.
folder_note: Any supported file dropped into the folder is indexed within a minute. Useful when documents already live on a network share.
offline_title: The search index is offline — the assistant is answering from memory only
offline_body_after: it cannot read any source, so questions about prices, hours or referrals get “I will have someone call you back”.
error_title: The index is corrupt after an unclean shutdown
error_body: The machine lost power while a document was being indexed. Your source files are untouched — rebuilding reads them again and takes about four minutes for this business.
